description: An individual item (lemma or morpheme pattern) has been mastered by a learner, per SPEC's private knowledge-tracing model. This is a lightweight notification event for downstream consumers (streak tracking, milestone badges, personal analytics). The authoritative per-encounter interpretation record lives in SPEC's private backend, not on the public firehose.

learnerDid.description: The learner who mastered this item. did:plc:... format.

itemId.description: The mastered item identifier. Format: dict:lemma:{id} or dict:pattern:{id}.

itemType.description: Whether this is a vocabulary lemma or a morpheme pattern.

priorW.description: W_i immediately before crossing tau. Must be < tau.

posteriorW.description: W_i immediately after crossing tau. Must be >= tau.

masteredAt.description: UTC timestamp when mastery was achieved.

sessionId.description: The learning session that produced this mastery update, per SPEC's private fitting session bookkeeping.

encounterCountAtMastery.description: Number of encounters required to achieve mastery. For lemmas: typically 5–15 for tau=0.60. For patterns: typically 3–10.

sourceEventRef.description: Opaque reference to the private interpretation record that triggered this mastery event. Resolved internally by SPEC's backend; not a public AT-URI collection.

difficultyAtMastery.description: Item difficulty score at time of mastery (from IRT b_i if available, else static score). Used for analytics: "mastered a hard item" vs "mastered an easy item".

register.description: Register of the content where mastery was achieved.
